name: HYDRA-UMC-HIL-BRIDGE
notes: Established v0 mode-based command routing (`route`/`mirror` subcommands): a real safety interlock blocks commands to real hardware whenever the twin reports an imminent collision, simulation-mode commands are never gated, and mirroring shadows a command into the twin unconditionally. CommandSink::send() now returns Result<(), TransportError> (Timeout/Disconnected); a new SimulatedTransport implementation models a slow or disconnected link with configurable latency/timeout, so the bridge's fail-safe behavior (a transport failure is reported as RouteOutcome::TransportFailure, never mistaken for SentReal/SentSimulation) is testable and exercisable via CLI flags without any real hardware. 14 tests. Real gRPC/WebSocket transport stays future work - genuinely blocked on no live HYDRA-UMC-TWIN/HYDRA-UMC controller to talk to yet, not just unwritten code.
